items.title: Inspiration alone won't solve Australia's teacher shortage, study reveals
items.summary: A $10 million Australian government campaign celebrating inspirational teachers risked overlooking the workplace conditions driving educators from the profession, according to new research led by Curtin University published in the Journal of Education Policy.

items.title: Kineski znanstvenici testirali oftalmološku kliniku koju vodi AI
items.summary: ZNANSTVENICI u Kini testirali su oftalmološku kliniku koju vodi AI. Uspjeh nije ovisio samo o algoritmu, već i o kvaliteti podataka, suradnji liječnika i brzini prilagodbe sustava.

items.title: Starfish program creates new jobs
items.summary: In a win for people and the environment, new economic modeling from James Cook University researchers reveals that a $5 million investment to control crown-of-thorns (CoTS) starfish numbers in the Cairns region created 61 new jobs and generated $20 million in economic activity.

items.title: Micro-dramas and the battle for attention
items.summary: As tech companies like Meta, Google and TikTok face ongoing scrutiny over addictive platform design, the rapid rise of micro-dramas offers a glimpse into how AI, algorithms and commercial incentives could make digital entertainment even harder to put down.

items.title: Improved climate forecasts alone won't protect Africa's poorest farmers
